title: AI Works Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for plugin-manifest.json files in the plugins/ directory

name.description: Unique plugin identifier, lowercase with hyphens

description.description: One-sentence description of what this plugin provides

homepage.description: URL for plugin documentation or repository

skills.description: Relative paths to skill directories provided by this plugin

items.description: Path relative to plugin root, e.g. 'skills/my-skill'

workflows.description: Relative paths to workflow YAML files provided by this plugin

items.description: Path relative to plugin root, e.g. 'workflows/my-workflow.yaml'

overrides.description: Base skill names that this plugin overrides. Must match a skill name in frontmatter.

dependencies.description: Other plugin names that must be loaded before this one

config_schema.description: JSON Schema for the plugin's config/settings.yaml file (if any)

tool_mappings.description: Relative paths to harness tool-mapping reference files
